{{Top|ga|leg}}
{{Quote|I knew he was invited to attend. I don't know what I was thinking even bringing it here.|Kime Enanrum, after Jar Jar Binks destroyed the sculptor's ice statue|<ref name="BinksDestroys">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_3.html|Rep. Binks Destroys Ice Statue at Gala Fundraiser}}</ref>}}
'''Kime Enanrum''' was a well-known [[Artist/Legends|sculptor]] who lived during the last [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], the sculptor created an [[Water/Legends|ice]] statue that was displayed at a fundraiser in the [[Jrade District/Legends|Jrade District]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, the intricately-crafted statue was accidentally destroyed by the notoriously maladroit [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], much to the sadness of Enanrum.

==Biography==
[[File:JarJarIce.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Represantive Jar Jar Binks, after destroying Enanrum's ice statue]]
Kime Enanrum was a famous [[Artist/Legends|sculptor]] who worked during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|235|Enanrum, Kime}}</ref> At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]<ref name="BinksDestroys" /> in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_3.html|Rep. Binks Destroys Ice Statue at Gala Fundraiser}} is set on the date [[Great ReSynchronization|13:2:28]], which corresponds to [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> Enanrum sculptured an elaborate statue from [[Water/Legends|ice]],<ref name="BinksDestroys" /> and organized a gala fundraiser<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|131|We Need to Talk About Jar Jar}}</ref> to take place in [[Jrade Plaza]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] posh [[Jrade District/Legends|Jrade District]] where the stature would be displayed. Unfortunately for the statue, [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was invited to the gala. Binks, who was infamous for his clumsiness, managed to accidentally tuck the tablecloth upon which the statue rested into his cummerbund. At the same time, he attempted to catch tumbling [[Canapé/Legends|canapés]] he had knocked from a nearby [[Waiter/Legends|waiter]], and, as a result, the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Congressman|Representative]] pulled down the statue, which shattered to pieces. The incident was reported by [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]], and Enanrum, saddened by the loss of the statue, gave an interview in which the sculptor expressed regret for bringing the statue at the gala in the first place.<ref name="BinksDestroys" />

==Personality and traits==
A successful sculptor, Kime Enanrum became renowned in that line of work.<ref name="TCSWE" /> Enanrum took time in creating the statue for the gala fundraiser, and the resulting piece was considered intricately-crafted. Despite knowing that Binks, who had just two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] prior demonstrated his clumsiness by deactivating the sky dome at the opening of the [[Endangered Shreebird Aviary]], was invited to the gala, Enanrum nonetheless decided to display the statue, though the sculptor later regretted that decision. When the statue was destroyed, Enanrum became crestfallen.<ref name="BinksDestroys" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kime Enanrum was first mentioned in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #45'']], an [[in-universe]] issue of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]<ref name="BinksDestroys" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]]<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] website<ref name="BinksDestroys" /> on [[February 28]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN45 date">Per {{JCFCite|url=posts/6042498|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-03-14|time=5:40 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220914072556/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-4#post-6042498}}, [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #47]] was released on [[March 14]], [[2002]]. As [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] segments were published weekly, and {{Hnn|45||A Closer Look}} was published two issues prior, it must have been released on [[February 28]] of the same year.</ref>
